scope: V33 saved40-train/10-eval folds,50 developers,Support5,candidates479; no V34 prepared305-user model, no background model, no fitting/tuning/selection
compound_proxy: At least2 positive products with nonempty and mutually non-nested actual MainAccord sets. Product-level proxy, not isolated family preference ground truth
pair_strict: At least1 same-product mutual positive AND a different SAME rated product positive for one and negative for the other
pair_evaluable: At least2 common rated products AND at least1 mutual-positive product; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for strict partial preference hypothesis
feature_overlap: Top/Middle/Base phrases and MainAccords stay separate; features of whole liked/disliked products do not identify isolated note preference
suspected_conflict: Negative Support max structural cosine > positive Support max structural cosine +1e-12; both anchors required, otherwise N/A
component_diagnostics: MF/content aligned when their available-score component-only rank is Top5 and other component rank is not. Numeric contribution shares also recorded. Descriptive, not a new evaluated recommender or causal attribution
structured_promotion: Structured final rank better than original H rank, especially original rank6..50 entering Top5
negative_rates: Confirmed negatives / observed-rated Top5 (conditional); also /all250 slots as known-negative lower bound; unknown ratings never negatives
hypothesis: Require direct same-product partial-preference witnesses and negative heldout Top5 linkage; MF transfer causality not identified by association
privacy: U01..U50 temporary aliases; no original user IDs, user hash mapping or full original rating rows exported
